NOTES:
1. PROVIDE SINGLE POINT POWER WITH NON-FUSED DISCONNECT.
2. ALL CHILLERS TO BE PROVIDED WITH PAINTED 3/4" THERMAL INSULATION ON COLD SURFACES.
3. PROVIDE WITH BACNET IP WITH ETHERNET COMMUNIATION CARD.
4. PROVIDE CHILLERS WITH FACTORY UNIT MOUNTED VFD WITH HARMONIC FILTER.
5. PROVIDE FACTORY RUN TEST, FACTORY START-UP, AND 5-YEAR ENTIRE UNIT PARTS, LABOR, AND REPLACEMENT REFRIGERANT WARRANTY. START-UP AND WARRANTY TO BE EXECUTED BY A FACTORY SERVICE EMPLOYEE, NOT AN "AUTHORIZED AGENT/REPRESENTATIVE."
6. PROVIDE THERMAL DISPERSION TYPE WATER FLOW SWITCHES AND DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE SWITCHES FOR EACH EVAPORATOR AND CONDENSER.
7. PROVIDE 0.028" COPPER TUBES IN EVAPORATOR AND 0.035" COPPER TUBES IN CONDENSER.
8. CHILLER SHALL UNLOAD TO 20% CAPACITY WITH 85°F CONDENSER WATER.
9. PROVIDE HINGES ON BOTH ENDS OF CONDENSER BARREL.
10. NPLV SHALL BE CALCULATED USING AHRI CONDENSER RELIEF AT 43°F LWT AND 55°F EWT FOR THE EVAPORATOR AND 85°F EWT AND 95°F LWT FOR THE CONDENSER. OPEN DRIVE MOTORS SHALL PROVIDE 1% BETTER EFFICIENCY TO COMPLY WITH ADDITIONAL HEAT LOSSES TO THE SPACE.
